azerbaijan.title: Flag of the Republic of Azerbaijan

colors.note: Represents Islam, the faith of the majority
The crescent and eight-pointed star emblem at the centre

desc:
- Three horizontal bands of blue, red, and green with a white crescent and eight-pointed star centred on the red band
- Originally adopted in 1918 by the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic and restored on 5 February 1991 during independence from the USSR
trivia:
- Popularly described as representing 'Turkism, modernism, and Islam' after a formulation attributed to early nationalist thinker Ali bey Huseynzade
- The eight points of the star are sometimes said to symbolise the eight branches of the Turkic peoples
- Azerbaijan was the first majority-Muslim country to grant women the vote, in 1918 under the flag's original adoption
